description:
Outcome: The owner can inspect understandable gardener and coordinator journeys, from brief.md §Users, §Constraints and v1 requirements 1–4; map excluded by owner deferral.
Scope: Synthetic wireframes/clickable prototype for application, own allocation, problem report, coordinator application review/allocation/waiting list and problem handling. Large text, plain language, keyboard focus/labels, non-colour statuses and narrow-screen layouts.
Excludes: Backend implementation and post-v1 plot map or replacement holder dashboard.
Acceptance: All first-version primary journeys include loading, empty, validation, error and recovery states. Screens remain legible and operable on phones. Allocation examples explain priority and later FCFS behaviour.
Behaviour: Show accessible validation and recovery rather than only success screens.
Verification: Owner walkthrough script and mobile/keyboard checks; present artifacts to T-005.
Prerequisites: none.
Assumptions: Prototype format chosen during ticket; no invented user research or performance targets.
title: Prototype accessible first-version phone journeys
